name: tempo
description: KOZMOS Tempo: a Pomodoro focus timer above the prompt. A tomato, the phase, a ring (desktop) or a sizzling bar (terminal) and the time left; long breaks every fourth round, a toast at each phase end and a tally of focus rounds per day. /tempo start [work] [break], stop, skip.

speak.title: Speak phase changes
speak.description: Also announce the end of each phase with the system voice.
